slides.heading: When should you actually change your calories?
One morning is not a signal.
slides.supporting: Bodyweight swings with water, food timing, salt and sleep.

slides.heading: Read the weekly trend, not the daily number.
slides.supporting: The line across the week tells you more than any one reading.

slides.heading: Wait for enough mornings before you judge it.
slides.supporting: Three or more weigh-ins in a week give the trend something to stand on.

slides.heading: Then decide. Change, or hold.
slides.supporting: Sometimes the honest call is to leave it exactly where it is.

slides.heading: This is the decision Volyume makes each week.
slides.supporting: It reads your logged data, calls change or hold, and writes the reason down.
